column10: LIMITATION CONTROL.  On a certificate whose read side names input 0 and whose commit side names input 1 -- a genuine mismatch -- the mode prints "sources say [(0, true)], flop records say [(1, true)]" and reports NO conflict, exit 0. column11: A clean exit from --reset-probe is therefore NOT evidence that the two reset records agree; a different-pin mismatch passes it.  reset_polarity_census.py classifies this case as raw-port:different-pin.
